title: Deepforge Miner
archiveRole: DeepSeek v4 Pro incremental economy observation sample
description: A space mining incremental clicker game. Click the asteroid to mine ore, purchase automated drones, upgrade through pickaxe to quantum extractor, unlock new asteroid fields with rare resources, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Canvas-rendered with particle effects, orbiting drone animations, floating damage numbers, and expanding click rings.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Desktop-first clicker tuned for mouse and keyboard at 1280x720 and above. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, tap-to-mine on the canvas, and tappable action buttons, but rapid clicking and fine UI are intended for desktop. No physical handset QA is claimed.
